title: Little Bighorn: The Regiment Custer Split in Three
summary: On June twenty-fifth and twenty-sixth, eighteen seventy-six, on the banks of the Little Bighorn River in Montana, Lieutenant Colonel George Armstrong Custer split the Seventh Cavalry Regiment into three and attacked Sitting Bull's vast Lakota and Cheyenne camp, and warriors led by Crazy Horse and Gall wiped out all five of Custer's companies. The episode goes from the gold found in the Black Hills in eighteen seventy-four and the broken Fort Laramie Treaty to Sitting Bull's Sun Dance vision of soldiers
